sources.license_observation: Figshare supplementary figures are CC BY 4.0; no individual raw profile dataset was acquired.
sources.measurement_description: Human bone-marrow MSC spheroids; Unisense OX-10 microelectrode at 25 degC, readings every 10 um toward center, n=5 in reported oxygen-profile figure. Measured medium oxygen reported as 267 uM (0.267 mol/m3).
reasons: Article presents profile means/plots; individual unaveraged radial tables and biological-unit identities were not acquired.
Supplementary materials listed by the primary article are three figure PDFs, not identified raw radial tables.
Figure digitization would not recover raw replicates or independent held-out identities.

sources.license_observation: Inspected Figshare manuscript archive is CC BY 4.0; no qualified raw numeric measurement cohort acquired.
sources.measurement_description: MCF7-R tumor hemi-spheroids measured using five gold micro-disc oxygen electrodes.
reasons: A hemi-spheroid on an electrode substrate needs an explicit geometry and boundary applicability argument before using the complete-sphere solver.
An example of voltammetry processing is not a raw calibrated complete-sphere profile cohort.
Direct radial per-specimen oxygen tables with independent calibration/validation biological identities were not acquired.
sources.archive_observation: Archive contains two DOCX and four PPTX files; no embedded spreadsheet/data members found in the four PPTX files.

decision: No raw dataset acquired satisfies this repository measurement contract. No public-data fit or physical/biological validation was performed.
method: Inspect primary article/repository methods, data availability and publicly listed files; refuse figure means, synthetic/model outputs, unidentified biological replicates, restricted files and incompatible units/geometry. This is a bounded source audit, not proof that no suitable public dataset exists.
